tagline: The world's leading accessible luxury jewellery brand
hero_kpi_rationale: Organic growth of 15% in Q2 2024 is the primary driver of value creation for Pandora, reflecting the success of the Phoenix strategy and brand transformation into a full jewellery brand with significant expansion in premium and accessible segments.

kpis.name: Organic growth
kpis.explanation: Revenue growth excluding foreign exchange and scope effects.
kpis.description: Organic growth reached 15% in Q2 2024, driven by new products and brand transformation.

kpis.name: Gross margin
kpis.explanation: Consolidated gross margin, measured as a percentage of revenue.
kpis.description: Gross margin reached 80.2% in Q2 2024, up 210 basis points year-over-year.
kpis.signal: Very high gross margin for the sector

kpis.name: Operating margin
kpis.description: Operating margin was 19.8%, down 40 basis points year-over-year.

kpis.name: Total comparable growth
kpis.description: Total comparable growth reached 8% in Q2 2024, driven by momentum in both Core and Fuel with more segments.

kpis.name: Core segment comparable growth
kpis.explanation: Comparable store sales performance for the Core product range.
kpis.description: The Core segment showed comparable growth of 1%, demonstrating resilience in a cautious consumer environment.

kpis.name: Fuel with more segment comparable growth
kpis.explanation: Comparable store sales growth for the premium Fuel with more product range.
kpis.description: The Fuel with more segment showed comparable growth of 29% in Q2 2024, demonstrating appeal for high-end products and the full jewellery brand strategy.
kpis.signal: Wow: exceptional growth in the premium segment

kpis.name: Return on invested capital
kpis.explanation: Company performance on its invested capital.
kpis.description: ROIC reached 45% in Q2 2024, reflecting highly efficient capital allocation and Pandora's superior business model.
kpis.signal: Very high ROIC, sign of capital efficiency

kpis.name: Net debt to EBITDA
kpis.explanation: Leverage ratio measuring net debt divided by EBITDA.
kpis.description: Net debt to EBITDA ratio was 1.4x in Q2 2024, reflecting a healthy balance sheet structure and significant cash flow generation.
kpis.signal: Very low leverage and strong balance sheet structure

ai_positioning.summary: Pandora mentions no AI-related initiatives in recent documents. The company focuses on brand transformation, customer experience, and vertical integration.
evidence: No mention of AI in Q2 2024 presentations
No references to AI tools in design or personalization
Absence of KPIs related to AI adoption or APIs
